column1: # kinds      strong: the word's Strong number becomes after (none where after is \N); before is the word and, after a space, the number it carries until then

# note       numbers the Open Hebrew Bible mapping (mapping/KJV-OT-mapped-to-BHS-full-mapping.csv) prints one word along: neighbours swapped, or a run carrying the next word's number (1 Chronicles 12:18-41), or a single word carrying the number of the word beside it (next to a ketiv the file numbers apart, a duplicate of a neighbour's number). Found where a word's number contradicts its BHSA lemma and fits a neighbour's, read against the lemma, Strong's dictionary, MACULA Hebrew and the King James tags by hand (PRB-1851)
